Class SmugglerCard

java.lang.Object

it.polimi.ingsw.is25am49.server.model.adventurecards.Enemy
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am49.server.model.adventurecards.SmugglerCard
public class SmugglerCard extends Enemy
Represents the SmugglerCard, a specific type of enemy in the game. This card handles battles and effects for winning or losing goods. Extends the Enemy class.

  • Constructor Details

    • SmugglerCard

      public SmugglerCard(GameBoard gameBoard, String description, int level, String name, int dayslost, int minimumFirePower, int redGoods, int yellowGoods, int greenGoods, int blueGoods, int lostGoods)
      Constructs a SmugglerCard object with the specified parameters and initializes its effects.
      Parameters:
      gameBoard - the game board associated with this card
      description - a brief description of the card
      level - the difficulty level of the card
      name - the name of the card
      dayslost - the number of days lost when this card is encountered
      minimumFirePower - the minimum firepower required to face this card
      redGoods - the amount of red goods won if the effect is triggered
      yellowGoods - the amount of yellow goods won if the effect is triggered
      greenGoods - the amount of green goods won if the effect is triggered
      blueGoods - the amount of blue goods won if the effect is triggered
      lostGoods - the amount of goods lost if the effect is triggered
